# Draft:Sorcerer Wars: The Wolf of the Valley

----
Sorcerer Wars: The Wolf of the Valley is a fantasy/war novel, and the first book in the Sorcerer Wars novel series by Nicholas Pusateri. The novel depicts Haley, a reckless and impulsive teenager who learns how to be mature and responsible after stumbling into the realm of Enchantimalia. She learns of the war between to Sorcerer clans: The good Cabalistics and the evil Subterauders. She is forced to take part after Emperor Siegfried, leader of the Subterauders turns her into a wolf. The Cabalistics and their kind leader, Mary Borealis train Haley to be a Sorceress.
